listing.title: My First Christmas Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Christmas Things – Santa, Christmas Tree, Reindeer, Snowman & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly Christmas things!

Little hands color 30 cute Christmas pages, from Santa, a Christmas tree and a reindeer to a gingerbread man, a candy cane and a mug of hot cocoa. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, most with happy faces, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Santa and his things: Santa, Santa Hat, Reindeer, Sleigh, Toy Sack, Chimney and Letter to Santa
  • Decorations: Christmas Tree, Ornament, Christmas Lights, Wreath, Stocking, Jingle Bell, Candle, Holly, Poinsettia, Snow Globe, Nutcracker and Pinecone
  • Gifts and treats: Gift, Bow, Candy Cane, Gingerbread Man, Gingerbread House, Hot Cocoa and Milk and Cookies
  • Winter friends and warm clothes: Snowman, Polar Bear, Christmas Sweater and Earmuffs
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
